origin: founding-agents-site #4 (PR #7): the builder wrote regexes for this rule and the reviewer sent them back three times, a new hole each round
summary: The page must use no colour or font outside tokens.css. Seven ways to break that must each fail check.sh, and two harmless lines must not.

issues.title: Check that the page uses only its design tokens
issues.body:
The page uses no colour or font that is not in `tokens.css`, wherever its CSS is written. Add a check for it, run from `check.sh`.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Files
`index.html`, `tests/`, `check.sh`, and the check's own config

## Technical decisions
None: a check inside the existing checks.
